# Sorcerer of the Fang (M20).
# "{5}{B}, {T}: This creature deals 2 damage to target opponent or planeswalker."
# Shape: B3-deal-dmg-const-player-or-planeswalker (Chandra's Magmutt) with the player side
# narrowed to opponents the way templates_b2b._target_opponent does: Zone(PLAYER, OPPONENT).
# The planeswalker side stays any planeswalker (the text does not restrict it).
ping = ActivatedAbility(
    cost=Cost(
        parts=(
            CostManaColor(color='B', amount=QConst(value=1)),
            CostManaGeneric(amount=QConst(value=5)),
            CostTap(),
        ),
    ),
    effect=A(Verb.DEAL_DAMAGE, {
        'amount': QConst(value=2),
        'target': Selector(
            count=QConst(value=1),
            mode=SelectorMode.TARGET,
            filter=FOr(
                children=(
                    FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.TYPE_EQ, string_value='Planeswalker'),
                    FNot(inner=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.IS_PERMANENT)),
                ),
            ),
            zones=(
                Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),
                Zone(kind=ZoneKind.PLAYER, controller=ControllerRef.OPPONENT),
            ),
        ),
    }),
)
abilities = [ping, *compiled]
